selection_method: From 10-build-history-diffs/output/structure/<site>.json: rows with error==null and >=1 sibling_group_event of kind insert|remove. Pairs ordered by first-parent commit order. Pairs taken as R runs of L consecutive pairs spread evenly across the ordered pair list (tempertemper R=3 L=15; alexcarpenter R=4 L=13; efcl R=2 L=13). Within chosen pairs, pairs in order then pages alphabetical; first insert|remove event per distinct (pair, page). Second pass over already-used (pair, page) combos if target unmet. Every selected commit verified present in 10's work/toolchain_<site>.json.
